tei:editionStmt.tei:p: Expanded Ashkenazi siddur: prayers in recitation order. Prayer words are transcluded from their source editions. Birnbaum supplies selected High Holiday services and rites, not a complete mahzor.

tei:sourceDesc.tei:bibl: This project arranges prayer text from Birnbaum 1949 and readings from the Humash and Tanakh editions. See the project index for the editorial arrangement.

tei:div.tei:head: פִּדְיוֹן הַבֵּן
REDEMPTION OF THE FIRST-BORN SON
tei:div.tei:note: Performed on the thirty-first day after birth. Should the child’s father be a kohen or a Levite, or the mother the daughter of a kohen or Levite, they are exempt from this duty. If the thirty-first day falls on a Sabbath or a major festival, the Pidyon ha-Ben is postponed until the following day.
Presenting the child to the kohen, the father says:
